title: Canonical surviving-degree smart window isomorphism
statement: For an abelian category C, q in N and a nonnegative cochain complex K, canonically identify degree q of the single smart window of K with H^q(K).

source.place: Proof steps 1 and 2, canonical single-window comparison

proof.text: Compose the upper-truncation boundary cycles isomorphism, cycles-to-homology (the lower truncation has zero incoming term), the inverse homology map of the lower truncation projection, and the extension homology isomorphism. These are actual Mathlib constructions; no existence witness is chosen.
